source: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem OData catalogue (catalogue.dataspace.copernicus.eu/odata/v1/Products)
query: Collection SENTINEL-1, product contains 'GRD', footprint intersects POINT(87.7218 22.6654), ContentDate/Start 2024-09-10 to 2024-09-28
note: Sentinel-1B was out of service and Sentinel-1C was not yet launched in September 2024, so all passes are Sentinel-1A. There was NO Sentinel-1 GRD acquisition over Ghatal on 18 September 2024.
baseline_rule: Pre-flood baseline must use the SAME relative orbit (12) and pass direction (ASCENDING) as the event granule, so incidence-angle differences do not masquerade as flood change. Expected 12-day-repeat baseline dates: 2024-09-07, 2024-08-26, 2024-08-14.
